text: Title the chart "Data Size".

text: Font size smaller.

@c1 syntax.clause form=fragment modifier="smaller" complement=$n1
alt:
@n1 syntax.nominal dependent="Font" head="size" dependent="smaller"
@c1 syntax.clause form=fragment complement=$n1
